name: quorum-downgrade-identity-collision
title: Stop the storyFilesHash downgrade from colliding a superseded quorum into permanent invalidity
description: eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade (core/review-escalation.ts) rewrites a host verdict's materialDigest to the current value when the verdict was recorded at an older material but its storyFilesHash still matches. The intent is benign. However quorum runIds are fixed (<storyId>-q-r1..r3) and quorum_submit reuses one synthetic hostId/sessionId/keyId per host, so when a story has submitted a quorum at two different materials that share a storyFilesHash, the older set is rewritten onto the current material and every runId ends up holding two verdicts per host. evaluateHostVerdictRounds (core/host-independence.ts) then invalidates all rounds with 'duplicate host/session/key identity', so the review-assurance floor reports 0/3 while a complete, on-disk-distinct 3x2 quorum genuinely exists at the current material. The story is then wedged: quorum_submit refuses to re-emit because (runId, materialDigest) already carries verdicts, and a fresh review round does not help because runIds are not round-scoped. The only exits are an unrelated material change or the human-gated review_escalation_fallback_set. Fix direction: when downgrading, skip the rewrite for a verdict whose (runId, host identity) is already represented by a verdict natively at the current material, keeping the advisory but never manufacturing a duplicate.
